title: Integrability of products of powers
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a measurable space with a finite measure, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^p(\mu)$ for a natural number $p$. If $a,b$ are natural numbers with $a+b\le p$, then the function $\omega\mapsto f(\omega)^a g(\omega)^b$ is integrable with respect to $\mu$.
replaced: Let $\mu$ be a finite measure, let $p,a,b\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $a+b\le p$, and let real functions $f,g\in L^p(\mu)$. Then $f^ag^b$ is integrable.
